stuck--adj.def: Unable to move, or unable to continue.
stuck--adj.ex: The key is stuck in the lock.

support--verb.def: To help someone, or to agree with an idea.

reach--noun.def: The distance over which you can stretch or arrive.
reach--noun.ex: Keep medicine out of children's reach.

experience--verb.def: To have something happen to you.

victim--noun.def: A person who is harmed by a crime or an accident.
victim--noun.ex: The victim was taken to hospital.

search--verb.def: To look carefully in order to find something.

arrest--noun.def: The act of the police taking someone into custody.
arrest--noun.ex: The arrest was shown on television.

arrest--verb.def: To take someone to a police station because of a crime.

rid--verb.def: To free a place or a person from something unwanted.
rid--verb.ex: We must rid the garden of weeds.

knock--verb.def: To hit a door or a surface to make a noise.

owe--verb.def: To have to pay money back to someone.
owe--verb.ex: I still owe him fifty lira.
owe--verb.exTr: Ona hâlâ elli lira borcum var.

worst--noun.def: The most unpleasant thing that could happen.
worst--noun.ex: The worst is already behind us.

patient--adj.def: Able to wait calmly without getting angry.
patient--adj.ex: Be patient, the bus will come.

escape--verb.def: To get away from a place where you are held.
escape--verb.ex: Two prisoners escaped during the night.

address--verb.def: To speak to a group, or to deal with a problem.

match--verb.def: To be equal or suitable, or to put similar things together.

press--noun.def: Newspapers and journalists as a group.
press--noun.ex: The press reported the story widely.

press--verb.def: To push something firmly, usually with your finger.
press--verb.ex: Press the green button to start.

bother--noun.def: Trouble or effort that annoys you a little.
bother--noun.ex: It was no bother at all.

foot--noun.def: The lowest part of something such as a hill or a page.
foot--noun.ex: The village lies at the foot of the mountain.

blame--noun.def: Responsibility for something bad that happened.
blame--noun.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.

type--verb.ex: She typed the letter in ten minutes.

mission--noun.def: An important job that a person or group is sent to do.
mission--noun.ex: The team returned from a long mission.

heaven--noun.def: The place where God is believed to live.
heaven--noun.ex: They believe she is in heaven now.

race--noun.def: A competition to see who is fastest.
race--noun.ex: He won the race by two seconds.

race--verb.def: To compete for speed against someone.
race--verb.ex: The boys raced to the gate.

risk--noun.def: The chance that something bad will happen.
risk--noun.ex: Smoking increases the risk of cancer.

further--adv.def: At a greater distance, or to a greater degree.

otherwise--adv.def: If the situation were different, or in other respects.
otherwise--adv.ex: Leave now, otherwise you will be late.
otherwise--adv.exTr: Şimdi çık, aksi hâlde geç kalırsın.

fit--verb.def: To be the right size or shape for something.
fit--verb.ex: These trousers no longer fit me.

notice--verb.def: To see or become aware of something.
notice--verb.ex: Did you notice the new sign?

smile--verb.def: To make a happy expression with your mouth.
smile--verb.ex: She smiled at the little girl.

enemy--noun.def: A person or country that opposes you.
enemy--noun.ex: He made few enemies in his life.

battle--noun.def: A fight between armies, or a hard struggle.

gay--adj.def: Attracted to people of the same sex.

department--noun.def: One part of a large organization or a store.
department--noun.ex: She works in the sales department.

guilty--adj.def: Having broken a law, or feeling bad about a fault.
guilty--adj.exTr: Yalan söylediği için kendini suçlu hissetti.

duty--noun.def: Something you must do because it is right or required.
duty--noun.ex: It is your duty to report it.

bunch--noun.def: A group of things held together, or a number of people.
bunch--noun.ex: He brought a bunch of flowers.

witness--verb.def: To see something happen, especially a crime.

upstairs--adj.def: On a higher floor of a building.

upstairs--noun.def: The part of a building above the ground floor.

arm--verb.def: To give weapons to a person or a group.
arm--verb.ex: The guards were armed with pistols.

pregnant--adj.def: Having a baby growing inside the body.
pregnant--adj.ex: His sister is six months pregnant.

waste--adj.def: No longer needed and thrown away.
waste--adj.ex: The factory treats its waste water.

waste--noun.def: Bad use of something valuable, or material thrown away.
waste--noun.ex: Throwing food away is a waste.

waste--verb.def: To use time, money or material badly.

taste--noun.def: The flavour of food, or what a person likes.
taste--noun.ex: The soup has a strong taste.

taste--verb.def: To try a little food, or to have a flavour.
taste--verb.ex: Taste the sauce before you serve it.
taste--verb.exTr: Servis etmeden önce sosun tadına bak.

form--verb.def: To make something exist or take shape.

lock--verb.def: To close something with a key so it cannot open.
lock--verb.ex: Lock the door when you leave.

above--adj.def: Written earlier on the same page.
above--adj.ex: Answer the above questions in order.

engine--noun.def: The machine that makes a vehicle move.
engine--noun.ex: The engine makes a strange noise.

written--adj.def: Put down in words on paper or a screen.

complete--verb.def: To finish something, or to fill in all its parts.
complete--verb.ex: Please complete the form in ink.

applause--noun.def: The sound of people clapping to show they like something.
applause--noun.ex: The applause lasted a full minute.

weapon--noun.def: An object used to hurt or kill in a fight.

burn--verb.def: To be on fire, or to damage something with fire.
burn--verb.ex: The old barn burnt to the ground.

treat--noun.def: Something special that you give someone for pleasure.
treat--noun.ex: Ice cream was a rare treat.

spirit--noun.def: A person's mood and energy, or a being without a body.
spirit--noun.ex: The team played with great spirit.

level--adj.def: Flat, or at the same height as something else.
level--adj.ex: Make sure the shelf is level.

interest--verb.def: To make someone want to know more.
interest--verb.exTr: Eski tarih onun çok ilgisini çekiyor.

bomb--noun.def: A weapon that explodes and destroys things.

bomb--verb.def: To attack a place with bombs.
bomb--verb.ex: The bridge was bombed in the war.

suspect--noun.def: A person the police think may have committed a crime.
suspect--noun.ex: The suspect was released at noon.

warm--verb.def: To make something warmer, or to become warmer.
warm--verb.ex: Warm the milk before you drink it.

extra--noun.def: Something additional, or an actor with no lines.

van--noun.def: A covered vehicle for carrying goods or people.
van--noun.ex: The van delivers bread every morning.

ridiculous--adj.def: So silly that it deserves to be laughed at.

shame--noun.def: A bad feeling about something wrong, or a pity.
shame--noun.ex: It is a shame you cannot come.

deserve--verb.def: To have earned something by what you did.
deserve--verb.exTr: Daha iyi bir işi hak ediyor.

lay--verb.def: To put something down carefully in a flat position.
lay--verb.ex: He laid the baby on the bed.

skin--noun.def: The outer covering of a body or a fruit.

responsible--adj.def: In charge of something, or the cause of it.
responsible--adj.ex: Who is responsible for this decision?

justice--noun.def: Fair treatment according to the law.
justice--noun.ex: The family is still seeking justice.
